plan.source_sampling: Draw three source-seed groups with replacement per tournament, same groups for all candidates and families.
plan.bot1: Both seats at all three seeds: six games.
plan.bot2: Choose one of the two existing proxies uniformly for the entire tournament; both seats at first two seeds: four games.
plan.astra: Choose one of the three existing proxies uniformly for the entire tournament; both seats at first two seeds: four games.
plan.score: 5 completion points assuming no forfeits; Bot1 wins>=5:+3,>=3:+2,>=1:+1; Bot2 wins>=3:+2,>=1:+1; Astra +1/win.
plan.selection_tie: Among reliable challengers within 0.5pp of highest Astra macro; highest paired mean positive score improvement, then fewest changed source lines relative to DARCL2, then stable name. DARCL2 is the fixed control. No proxy simulation is a course receipt.

scope: Paired local proxy interpretation; not calibrated to formal course scores.
